title: Named-Prescriber Enforcement Forborne
content: DOPL forgoes unlawful-conduct and unprofessional-conduct enforcement under §58-1-501(1)-(2) and related professional-licensing provisions against any provider who (1) acts solely as the named prescriber for AI-authorized renewals and (2) does not interact directly with a patient or other provider. Legion §16(D) adds a condition that the provider abides by the agreement and any agreement with the participant; Doctronic §15(D) states no such condition. The covered chapter provisions differ by agreement. Forbearance applies only to conduct authorized by the agreement.
pub:source_review_unresolved: The signed source PDF body retains the title DRAFT AGREEMENT although the official OAIP page and filename present it as final and the PDF contains signatures dated October 23-24, 2025.
The May 19, 2026 outcomes report says its limited sample is based on reports from Doctronic physicians and that OAIP initiated a separate independent review.

OAIP's register and FAQ describe a 2026 amendment changing the Phase 2 criteria and removing two medications, which conflicts with the retained signed agreement; no amendment document is linked, so its date, signatories, and exact text are unverified.

No retained source shows an extension request or decision under Section 13, a termination, or compliance; the register's Active status and Phase 1 statement are agency web statements retrieved 2026-09-24.
The register's third-party adversarial testing term and the FAQ's malpractice insurance expectation do not appear in the retained signed agreement text.
The UAC R156-1 link returned HTTP 404 and was removed; no current official Office of Administrative Rules URL was retained.

October 15, 2026 UTC re-observation: the linked signed PDF is byte-identical to the retained September source, while the register and FAQ describe changed Phase 2 criteria and formulary. No amendment, written Proposal approval, Phase 2 approval or extension decision was identified among links on the three selected pages; no claim that those documents do not exist or that the pilot continues past October 24.

The current FAQ describes a general program allowance of up to two extensions; original Agreement Section 13 permits a single extension request. No new codification bridge, instrument amendment or extension decision was reviewed, and the source-specific wording remains distinct.
The Doctronic signed text cites 59-67-502 and 59-70a-503, which appear to be typographical errors for chapter 58 provisions; reproduced as written with [sic].
This agent review does not renew last_verified or authenticate human review.
